title: Airy Silky Japanese Milk Chocolate Kushikatsu
description: A delicate Japanese dessert featuring milk chocolate in a silky and airy kushikatsu form, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour and cornstarch.
In a large bowl, whisk together egg whites and granulated sugar until stiff peaks form.
Melt the milk chocolate in a double boiler and let it cool slightly.
Add the melted chocolate, melted butter, whole milk, and vanilla extract to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the chocolate mixture and whisk until just combined.
Pour the mixture into individual mini cocottes.
Bake for 12 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Let the kushikatsu cool in the cocottes for 5 minutes before serving.
